layouts.name: Rosario Alt Extended Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Historical layout retains the angular northwestern inner return and stepped southwestern inner corner from the pinned 2020 public snapshot, including independently mapped former raceway connections. The northeastern extension is included for extended entries and excluded for the intermediate entry. The source labels these former raceway branches as disused; they are used only to represent the historical course. The series venue history identifies the original circuit and later extensions; supplied branch identity distinguishes this layout. Exact coordinates remain unchanged. Both extended names share this mapped route; their small recorded difference remains unrepresented and requires alignment review. Pit alternatives excluded. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3336.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
